about: The rules register (Tzvi, 12 Nov 2026: rules as a building blueprint). One record per rule: how it is built (KIT starter code, GEN a script from the blueprint answers, ASK one blueprint question, OWNER the owner message, EYE the final review), what builds it, what confirms it. status built = a starter part does it today; planned = still to build. A new rule is added here with its building part the same day (check-rule-homes).
